en.s: The Battle of Clitheroe was a battle between a force of Scots and English knights and men at arms which took place on 10 June 1138 during the period of The Anarchy. The battle was fought on the southern edge of the Bowland Fells, at Clitheroe, Lancashire. It took place in the course of an invasion of England by King David I of Scotland. In the summer of 1138, King David split his army into two forces. One of them, commanded by William fitz Duncan, Mormaer of Moray, marched into Lancashire. There he harried Furness and Craven.

zh.s: 克利瑟罗战役于1138年6月10日在“无政府时期”爆发，交战双方是苏格兰军队与英格兰骑士和重装步兵。战场位于兰开夏郡克利瑟罗、博兰丘陵南缘。战斗发生在苏格兰国王大卫一世入侵英格兰期间。1138年夏，大卫将军队分成两支，其中一支由莫里伯爵威廉·菲茨·邓肯率领，进军兰开夏郡并袭扰弗内斯和克雷文地区。

en.s: The Battle of Marj Ayyun was a military confrontation fought at Marj Ayyun near the Litani River (modern-day Lebanon) in June 1179 between the Kingdom of Jerusalem under Baldwin IV and the Ayyubid armies under the leadership of Saladin. It ended in a decisive victory for the Muslims and is considered the first in the long series of Islamic victories under Saladin against the Christians.

zh.s: 1179年6月，耶路撒冷王国鲍德温四世的军队与萨拉丁率领的阿尤布王朝军队在利塔尼河附近的马尔杰阿尤恩交战，今属黎巴嫩。穆斯林军队取得决定性胜利；这被视为萨拉丁此后连番击败基督徒军队的首场胜利。

en.t: Frederick Barbarossa drowns during the Third Crusade
en.s: Emperor Frederick Barbarossa drowned while crossing the Saleph River on June 10, 1190, as he led a crusader army through Anatolia. His death shattered the German contingent; many of his soldiers turned back instead of reaching the Holy Land.

zh.t: 腓特烈·巴巴罗萨在第三次十字军东征途中溺亡
zh.s: 1190年6月10日，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨率十字军穿过安纳托利亚时，在渡过萨莱夫河的途中溺亡。他的死使德意志十字军失去主帅，许多士兵放弃继续前往圣地。

en.s: The Battle of Pelekanon, also known by its Latinised form Battle of Pelecanum, occurred on June 10–11, 1329, between an expeditionary force by the Byzantines led by Andronikos IIl and an Ottoman army led by Orhan I. The Byzantine army was defeated, with no further attempt made at relieving the cities in Anatolia under Ottoman siege.

zh.s: 佩莱卡农战役也称佩莱卡努姆战役，于1329年6月10日至11日爆发，交战双方是安德洛尼卡三世率领的拜占庭远征军与奥尔汗一世率领的奥斯曼军队。拜占庭军队战败，此后再未尝试解救安纳托利亚遭奥斯曼围困的城市。

en.s: The Battle of Mello was the decisive and largest engagement of the Peasant Jacquerie of 1358, a rebellion of peasants in the Beauvais region of France, a major upheaval in this region at the height of the Hundred Years' War with England. The battle was fought at almost the same time as another major battle fought at Meaux, where the Jacquerie rebels (or Jacques Bonhommes) joined the Parisian militia in assaulting a royal stronghold.

zh.s: 梅洛之战是1358年法国博韦地区农民扎克雷起义中规模最大、起决定性作用的战斗。当时英法百年战争正酣，起义令当地局势剧烈动荡。几乎同时，莫城也发生大战：扎克雷起义者与巴黎民兵共同攻打一处王室据点。

en.s: The siege of Deventer was a siege of the city of Deventer from 1 to 10 June 1591 during the Eighty Years' War by Dutch and English troops under Maurice of Nassau in an attempt to retake it from its Spanish garrison, commanded by Herman van den Bergh on behalf of the Spanish.

zh.s: 代芬特尔围城战发生于1591年6月1日至10日。八十年战争期间，拿骚的莫里斯率领荷兰和英格兰军队围攻代芬特尔，试图从西班牙守军手中夺回该城。守军由赫尔曼·范登贝格代表西班牙指挥。

en.t: Willem Barents and Jacob van Heemskerk discover Bear Island
en.s: Bear Island (Norwegian: Bjørnøya, pronounced [ˈbjø̀ːɳœʏɑ]) is the southernmost island of the Norwegian Svalbard archipelago. The island is located at the limits of the Norwegian and Barents seas, approximately halfway between Spitsbergen and the North Cape. Bear Island was discovered by Dutch explorers Willem Barentsz and Jacob van Heemskerck on 10 June 1596. It was named after a polar bear that was seen swimming nearby.

zh.t: 威廉·巴伦支和雅各布·范·海姆斯凯尔克发现熊岛
zh.s: 熊岛（挪威语：Bjørnøya，读音：[ˈbjø̀ːɳœʏɑ]）是挪威斯瓦尔巴群岛最南端的岛屿，位于挪威海与巴伦支海交界处，大致在斯匹次卑尔根岛和北角之间。1596年6月10日，荷兰探险家威廉·巴伦支和雅各布·范·海姆斯凯尔克发现了熊岛。岛名来自他们在附近看到的一头游泳的北极熊。

en.s: The War of the Jülich Succession, also known as the Jülich War or the Jülich-Cleves Succession Crises (German: Jülich-Klevischer Erbfolgestreit), was a war of succession in the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg. The first phase of the war lasted between 10 June 1609 and 24 October 1610, with the second phase starting in May 1614 and finally ending on 13 October 1614.

zh.s: 于利希继承战争又称于利希战争或于利希—克莱沃继承危机，是于利希—克莱沃—贝格联合公国爆发的继承战争。第一阶段从1609年6月10日持续到1610年10月24日；第二阶段于1614年5月开始，最终于同年10月13日结束。

en.s: The Battle of Sablat or Záblatí occurred on 10 June 1619, during the Bohemian period of the Thirty Years' War. The battle was fought between a Roman Catholic Imperial army led by Charles Bonaventure de Longueval, Count of Bucquoy and the Protestant army of Ernst von Mansfeld. When Mansfeld was on his way to reinforce general Hohenloe, who was besieging Budějovice (German: Budweis), Buquoy intercepted Mansfeld near the small village of Záblatí (German: Sablat), about 25 km (16 mi) km NW of Budějovice, and brought him to battle. Mansfeld suffered defeat, losing at least 1,500 infantry and his baggage train.

zh.s: 萨布拉战役又称扎布拉蒂战役，于1619年6月10日在三十年战争的波希米亚阶段爆发。查尔斯·博纳文图尔·德·隆格瓦尔伯爵·德·布屈瓦率领天主教帝国军，与恩斯特·冯·曼斯费尔德率领的新教军交战。曼斯费尔德当时正赶去增援围攻布杰约维采（德语名：布德魏斯）的霍恩洛厄将军，布屈瓦在布杰约维采西北约25公里处、扎布拉蒂小村附近拦截了他并发起进攻。曼斯费尔德战败，至少损失1,500名步兵和全部辎重。

en.s: The Treaty of Compiègne, signed on 10 June 1624, was a mutual defence alliance between the Kingdom of France and the Dutch Republic, for an initial period of three years. One of a series of treaties designed to isolate Spain, France agreed to subsidise the Dutch in their War of Independence in return for naval assistance, as well as trading privileges.

zh.s: 《贡比涅条约》于1624年6月10日签署，是法国王国与荷兰共和国签订的共同防御联盟，初始期限为三年。该条约是孤立西班牙的一系列条约之一。法国同意补贴荷兰的独立战争，以换取海军援助和贸易特权。

en.s: The naval Battle of Puerto de Cavite took place on 10 June 1647 during the Eighty Years' War between a Spanish fleet and a Dutch fleet in Puerto de Cavite, an important Spanish port in Manila Bay, Philippines in which the Dutch were defeated.

zh.s: 卡维特港海战于1647年6月10日在八十年战争期间爆发，交战双方是西班牙舰队和荷兰舰队，地点在菲律宾马尼拉湾的重要西班牙港口卡维特。荷兰舰队战败。

en.s: The Battle of Hutong was a military conflict which occurred on 10 June 1658 between the Tsardom of Russia and the Qing dynasty and Joseon. It resulted in Russian defeat.

zh.s: 虎洞战役于1658年6月10日爆发，交战双方是俄罗斯沙皇国与清朝和朝鲜。俄军战败。

en.s: The siege of Groenlo was a 10-day siege of the Dutch town of Groenlo from 1 to 10 June 1672 by the combined forces of France, the Elector of Cologne and the Prince-Bishop of Münster during the Franco-Dutch War. It ended in the town's surrender.

zh.s: 格罗恩洛围城战是法荷战争期间的一场围城战。1672年6月1日至10日，法国、科隆选侯和明斯特采邑主教的联军围攻荷兰城镇格罗恩洛，历时10天，最终该镇投降。

en.s: Grovestins' cavalry raid was a successful raid carried out in Champagne, France, by a Dutch States Army brigade under Major-general Frederik Sirtema van Grovestins between 10 June 1712 and 28 July 1712 during the final stages of the War of the Spanish Succession.

zh.t: 格罗韦斯廷斯骑兵突袭
zh.s: 格罗韦斯廷斯骑兵突袭是西班牙王位继承战争末期的一次成功突袭，由弗雷德里克·西尔特马·范·格罗韦斯廷斯少将率领的荷兰共和国军队旅于1712年6月10日至7月28日在法国香槟地区执行。

en.s: The Battle of Glen Shiel (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Ghleann Seile) was a battle in Glen Shiel, in the West Highlands of Scotland on 10 June 1719, between British government troops (mostly Scots) and an alliance of Jacobites and Spanish, resulting in a victory for the government forces. It was the last close engagement of British and foreign troops in Great Britain. The Battle of Glen Shiel is sometimes considered an extension of the Jacobite rising of 1715, but is more correctly a separate rebellion and was the only rising to be extinguished by a single military action.

zh.s: 格伦希尔战役（苏格兰盖尔语：Blàr Ghleann Seile）于1719年6月10日在苏格兰西部高地的格伦希尔爆发，交战双方是英国政府军（主要由苏格兰人组成）与雅各派和西班牙联军。政府军获胜。这是英国境内英国军队与外国军队最后一次近距离交战。格伦希尔战役有时被视为1715年雅各派起义的延续，但更准确地说，它是一次单独的叛乱，也是唯一一次通过一场军事行动就被平定的起义。

en.s: The capture of the sloop Ranger occurred on June 10, 1723 near Block Island in the Atlantic Ocean. Two pirate ships under the command of Englishmen Edward Low and Charles Harris attacked HMS Greyhound, a post ship of the Royal Navy which they mistook for a civilian whaler. The resulting engagement lasted for several hours and ended with Harris' sloop Ranger being captured by Greyhound while Low's schooner Fancy escaped.

zh.t: 单桅帆船“游骑兵号”被俘
zh.s: 单桅帆船“游骑兵号”被俘事件发生于1723年6月10日，地点在大西洋的布洛克岛附近。英国海盗爱德华·洛和查尔斯·哈里斯率领两艘海盗船袭击了英国皇家海军邮船“灰狗号”，他们误以为对方是捕鲸船。交战持续数小时，最终哈里斯的单桅帆船“游骑兵号”被“灰狗号”俘获，洛的纵帆船“幻想号”则逃走。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Palos was a naval engagement that took place between 9 and 10 June 1758, during the Spanish-Barbary Wars. A Spanish squadron of three warships intercepted an Algerian squadron of two warships escorting a prize ship. After a prolonged fight, the Algiers flagship surrendered. His consort eluded the battle, but wrecked and the prize ship escaped.

zh.s: 帕洛斯角海战于1758年6月9日至10日西班牙—巴巴里战争期间爆发。西班牙三艘军舰截获了由两艘阿尔及利亚军舰护送的一艘战利品船。经过长时间交战，阿尔及利亚旗舰投降。另一艘护航舰逃离战斗后搁浅，战利品船则成功逃脱。

en.t: Ten days after being formed by an earthquake, a landslide dam on the Dadu River in China was destroyed by an aftershock, causing a flood that killed an estimated 100,000 people
en.s: An earthquake occurred on 1 June 1786 in and around Kangding, in what is now China's Sichuan province. It had an estimated magnitude of about 7.75 and a maximum perceived intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. The initial quake killed 435 people. After an aftershock nine days later, a further 100,000 died when a landslide dam collapsed across the Dadu River.

zh.t: 1786年大渡河滑坡堰塞湖溃决洪水
zh.s: 1786年6月1日，四川康定—泸定一带发生约7.75级地震，最高烈度约为麦加利烈度表的X级（极强）。主震引发山体滑坡并堵塞大渡河，造成435人死亡。随后发生的余震使堰塞湖溃决，下游洪水又造成约10万人死亡。

en.t: Tripoli's ruler signs treaty ending the First Barbary War
en.s: Yusuf Karamanli, ruler of Tripoli, signed a treaty with the United States on June 10, 1805, ending their hostilities in the First Barbary War. The agreement provided for the exchange of prisoners.

zh.t: 的黎波里统治者签署结束第一次巴巴里战争的条约
zh.s: 1805年6月10日，的黎波里统治者优素福·卡拉曼利与美国签署条约，结束两国在第一次巴巴里战争中的敌对行动。条约还约定交换战俘。

en.s: The Battle of Heilsberg took place on 10 June 1807, during the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 海尔斯贝格战役于1807年6月10日爆发，是拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Prestebakke was fought on 10 June 1808, between Swedish and Norwegian forces, during the Dano-Swedish War of 1808–09. After the Swedish retreat out of Norway, a small detachment was left at Prestebakke and Berby. Christian August ordered a Norwegian offensive to drive them out, which was carried out by Arild Huitfeldt. Georg Adlersparre had the overall command, but was not present; instead, von Knorring acted as commander at the battle.

zh.s: 普雷斯特巴克战役于1808年6月10日在丹麦—瑞典战争（1808—1809年）期间爆发，交战双方是瑞典和挪威军队。瑞典军队撤出挪威后，在普雷斯特巴克和贝尔比留下了一支小部队。克里斯蒂安·奥古斯特下令挪威军队发起进攻，将其赶走；行动由阿里尔德·许特费尔特执行。乔治·阿德勒斯帕雷负责总指挥，但他没有到场，战斗由冯·克诺林指挥。

en.s: The second siege of Badajoz (22 April – 12 May and 18 May – 10 June, 1811) saw an Anglo-Portuguese Army, first led by William Carr Beresford and later commanded by Arthur Wellesley, the Viscount Wellington, besiege a French garrison under Armand Philippon at Badajoz, Spain. After failing to force a surrender, Wellington withdrew his army when the French mounted a successful relief effort by combining the armies of Marshals Nicolas Soult and Auguste Marmont.

zh.t: 巴达霍斯第二次围城战（1811年）
zh.s: 巴达霍斯第二次围城战的时间为1811年4月22日至5月12日，以及5月18日至6月10日。威廉·卡尔·贝雷斯福德先后率领英葡联军，后来由威灵顿子爵阿瑟·韦尔斯利指挥，围攻西班牙巴达霍斯由阿尔芒·菲利蓬率领的法军守军。未能迫使守军投降后，法军元帅尼古拉·苏尔特和奥古斯特·马尔蒙联军成功前来解围，威灵顿于是撤军。

en.s: The Battle of Vasilika was fought on 10 June 1821 in Greece, between the Ottoman and the Greek forces led by the Captain Stamatios Kapsas.

zh.t: 瓦西利卡战役（塞萨洛尼基）
zh.s: 瓦西利卡战役于1821年6月10日在希腊爆发，交战双方是奥斯曼军队与斯塔马蒂奥斯·卡普萨斯上尉率领的希腊军队。

en.s: The Battle of Kompoti was a military engagement of the Greek War of Independence, with a victorious outcome for the Greeks.

zh.s: 孔波蒂之战是希腊独立战争中的一场战斗，希腊军队获胜。

en.s: The Port Cresson massacre was a lopsided battle that occurred on June 10, 1835, in the territory of modern-day Liberia between American-born Liberian settlers, many descendants of American slaves, on the one hand and Bassa forces on the other. After the massacre American forces retaliated and routed the Bassa, compelling them to terms for peace.

zh.s: 克雷森港屠杀是1835年6月10日在今利比里亚境内发生的一场一边倒的战斗，交战双方是美国出生的利比里亚移民（其中许多是美国奴隶的后代）与巴萨人。屠杀发生后，美军展开报复并击败巴萨人，迫使他们接受和平条件。

en.s: The Myall Creek massacre was the killing of at least 28 unarmed Aboriginal people in the Colony of New South Wales by eight colonists on 10 June 1838 at the Myall Creek in the north of the colony. Seven perpetrators were convicted of murder and hanged. This was one of the few alleged massacres of Aboriginal people to have been proven in court.

zh.s: 1838年6月10日，新南威尔士殖民地迈尔溪发生屠杀。8名殖民者杀害了至少28名手无寸铁的原住民。7名行凶者后来被判谋杀罪并处以绞刑。这是少数在法庭上被证实发生过的原住民屠杀事件之一。

en.t: Nauvoo militia destroys the Nauvoo Expositor printing press
en.s: On June 10, 1844, Nauvoo's city council declared the Nauvoo Expositor newspaper a public nuisance and authorized Joseph Smith to destroy its printing press. Members of the Nauvoo Legion wrecked the press and burned available copies of the paper.

zh.t: 纳府民兵捣毁《纳府揭露者》报社印刷机
zh.s: 1844年6月10日，美国伊利诺伊州纳府市议会将《纳府揭露者》报视为“公害”，授权约瑟夫·史密斯销毁其印刷机。随后，纳府军团成员闯入报社，砸毁印刷机，并烧毁能找到的报纸。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 10 June 1845 in which the 95 seats in the Chamber of Representatives were elected. Voter turnout was 77.0%, although only 22,771 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections were held in only five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders.

zh.s: 比利时于1845年6月10日举行大选，选出众议院95席。投票率为77.0%，但只有22,771人具备投票资格。根据轮替制度，九个省中只有安特卫普、布拉班特、卢森堡、那慕尔和西佛兰德五省举行选举。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 10 June 1856. In the elections for the Chamber of Representatives the result was a victory for the Catholics, who won 63 of the 108 seats. Voter turnout was 60.6%, although only 43,573 people were eligible to vote.

zh.s: 比利时于1856年6月10日举行部分大选。在众议院选举中，天主教派获胜，赢得108席中的63席。投票率为60.6%，但只有43,573人具备投票资格。

en.s: The Battle of Big Bethel, also known as the Battle of Bethel Church or Great Bethel, was one of the earliest land battles of the American Civil War. It took place on the Virginia Peninsula, near Newport News, on June 10, 1861. Virginia's decision to secede from the Union had been ratified by popular vote on May 23, and Confederate colonel (later major general) John B.

zh.s: 大贝瑟尔之战又称贝瑟尔教堂之战，是美国内战最早的陆战之一，1861年6月10日发生在弗吉尼亚半岛、纽波特纽斯附近。弗吉尼亚州退出联邦的决定此前于5月23日经全民投票通过。邦联上校约翰·B.马格鲁德随后被派到半岛，阻止驻门罗堡的联邦军向州首府里士满推进。

en.s: The 1863 Capture of Mexico City by French forces took place on June 10, 1863. With the French victory at the Siege of Puebla, the position of the Mexican Republican government was untenable. As soon as the federal government left the capital, General Bruno Martinez, commander of the garrison of the town, issued a manifesto in favor of intervention, recognizing French commanding general Élie Frédéric Forey as the highest authority in Mexico. On June 10, the bulk of the French army entered the city under the direct command of General Forey.

zh.s: 法国军队于1863年6月10日攻占墨西哥城。法军在普埃布拉围城战中获胜后，墨西哥共和政府已无法立足。联邦政府一离开首都，驻军司令布鲁诺·马丁内斯将军便发表宣言支持干预，并承认法国远征军司令埃利·弗雷德里克·福雷为墨西哥最高权力者。6月10日，福雷将军亲自率领大部分法军进入墨西哥城。

en.s: French troops occupied Mexico City on June 10, 1863, during the Second French Intervention in Mexico. Conservative Mexican leaders then moved closer to the French; a new governing junta was formed later that month.

zh.t: 法国军队占领墨西哥城
zh.s: 1863年6月10日，法国军队在第二次武装干涉墨西哥期间占领墨西哥城。此后，墨西哥保守派与法军进一步合作，并在当月组建了新的执政机构。

en.s: The Battle of Brice's Crossroads, also known as the Battle of Tishomingo Creek and the Battle of Guntown, was fought on Friday, June 10, 1864, near Baldwyn, Mississippi, then part of the Confederate States of America. A Federal expedition from Memphis, Tennessee, of 4,800 infantry and 3,300 cavalry, under the command of Brigadier-General Samuel Sturgis, was defeated by a Confederate force of 3,500 cavalry under the command of Major-General Nathan Forrest. The battle was a victory for the Confederates. Forrest inflicted heavy casualties on the Federal force and captured more than 1,600 prisoners of war, 18 artillery pieces, and wagons loaded with supplies.

zh.s: 布赖斯十字路口战役又称蒂肖明戈溪战役或冈敦战役，于1864年6月10日星期五在密西西比州鲍德温附近爆发，当时该地区属于南方邦联。塞缪尔·斯特吉斯准将率领4,800名步兵和3,300名骑兵从田纳西州孟菲斯出发，遭到纳撒尼尔·福雷斯特少将率领的3,500名南军骑兵击败。南军获胜，福雷斯特重创联邦军，俘获1,600多名战俘、18门火炮和装满补给的马车。

en.s: The Battle of São Borja was fought on 10 June 1865 at the beginning of the Paraguayan invasion of Rio Grande do Sul during the Paraguayan War.

zh.s: 圣博尔哈战役于1865年6月10日爆发，是巴拉圭战争期间巴拉圭入侵南里奥格兰德州初期的一场战斗。

en.t: Mihailo Obrenović III, Prince of Serbia is assassinated
en.s: Mihailo Obrenović III (Serbian Cyrillic: Михаило Обреновић, romanized: Mihailo Obrenović; 16 September 1823 – 10 June 1868) was the ruling Prince of Serbia from 1839 to 1842 and again from 1860 to 1868. His first reign ended when he was deposed in 1842, and his second ended when he was assassinated in 1868.

zh.t: 塞尔维亚亲王米哈伊洛·奥布雷诺维奇三世遇刺身亡
zh.s: 米哈伊洛·奥布雷诺维奇三世（塞尔维亚语西里尔字母：Михаило Обреновић；罗马字转写：Mihailo Obrenović；1823年9月16日—1868年6月10日）曾于1839至1842年及1860至1868年两度担任塞尔维亚亲王。他的第一次在位因1842年被废黜而结束，第二次在位则因1868年遇刺身亡而终止。

en.s: Russian forces entered Khiva, the capital of the Khanate of Khiva, on June 10, 1873. General Konstantin von Kaufmann entered the city after troops under General Nikolai Veryovkin had fought at its northern gate. The city is now in Uzbekistan. A separate treaty in August made the khanate a Russian protectorate.
en.n: June 10 is the Gregorian date of Kaufmann's entry; Encyclopaedia Iranica records the same day as May 29 in the Julian calendar. The protectorate treaty followed in August.

zh.s: 1873年6月10日，俄军进入希瓦汗国首都希瓦。此前，韦列夫金将军率部在北门与守军交战；随后，考夫曼将军率军入城。希瓦如今位于乌兹别克斯坦。直到同年8月，俄国与希瓦签订条约，希瓦汗国才成为俄国的保护国。
zh.n: 6月10日是考夫曼入城的公历日期；《伊朗百科全书》使用儒略历，记为5月29日。保护国条约在8月签订。

en.t: Albanian delegates found the League of Prizren
en.s: Albanian delegates founded the League of Prizren in Prizren, then part of the Ottoman Empire and now in Kosovo, on June 10, 1878. The group organized to defend Albanian-inhabited territories and political rights amid plans to redraw Balkan borders following the Russo-Turkish War. The Congress of Berlin was due to open three days later.
en.n: June 10 is the League's founding assembly, not the March signing of the Treaty of San Stefano or a decision of the later Congress of Berlin.

zh.t: 阿尔巴尼亚代表在普里兹伦成立联盟
zh.s: 1878年6月10日，阿尔巴尼亚各地代表在普里兹伦成立普里兹伦联盟。这里当时属于奥斯曼帝国，如今位于科索沃。俄土战争结束后，巴尔干半岛的边界面临重划；联盟成立的目的是维护阿尔巴尼亚人聚居地区及其政治权利。三天后，柏林会议才开幕。
zh.n: 6月10日是联盟成立大会的日期，不是《圣斯特凡诺条约》的签署日，也不是后来柏林会议作出决定的日期。

en.s: The most recent eruption of Mount Tarawera occurred in the early hours of June 10 1886 in the North Island, New Zealand. It is the deadliest eruption in New Zealand since the arrival of Europeans. Up to 150 people, mostly Māori, were killed, and many settlements were destroyed or buried by the eruption of Mount Tarawera.

zh.s: 塔拉威拉山最近一次喷发于1886年6月10日凌晨发生在新西兰北岛。这是欧洲人抵达新西兰以来死亡人数最多的一次喷发，造成多达150人死亡，多数为毛利人；许多聚落被喷发摧毁或掩埋。

en.s: The 1887 Invercargill mayoral by-election was held on 10 June 1887 to fill the vacancy left by the resignation of David Roche. Aaron Blacke had been appointed mayor by the council, but this was not done in strict accordance with the law, and Blacke is not included in official lists of Mayors of Invercargill. Edwin Alfred Tapper was elected.

zh.s: 因弗卡吉尔于1887年6月10日举行市长补选，以填补大卫·罗奇辞职后的空缺。阿伦·布莱克曾由市议会任命为市长，但任命程序不完全符合法律，因此官方市长名册不列入布莱克。埃德温·阿尔弗雷德·塔珀当选。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 10 June 1890. In the elections for the Chamber of Representatives the result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 94 of the 138 seats. Under the alternating system, elections were held in only four out of the nine provinces: Hainaut, Limburg, Liège and East Flanders. Thus, only 69 seats out of the 138 were up for election. Additionally, a special election was held in Neufchâteau on 3 June 1890 after the death of Edmond van der Linden d'Hooghvorst (d). Winand Heynen (d) was elected to replace him.

zh.s: 比利时于1890年6月10日举行部分大选。在众议院选举中，天主教党获胜，赢得138席中的94席。根据轮替制度，九个省中只有埃诺、林堡、列日和东佛兰德四省举行选举。因此，本轮只改选138席中的69席。此外，埃德蒙·范德林登·德霍赫沃斯特去世后，纽夫沙托选区于1890年6月3日举行特别选举，由维南德·海宁当选接替他。

en.t: U.S. Marines land at Guantánamo Bay, Cuba
en.s: A U.S. Marine battalion landed at Guantánamo Bay, Cuba, on June 10, 1898, during the Spanish–American War. Four of its six companies went ashore without opposition and established a position on the east side of the bay.
en.n: The June 10 landing is separate from the flag raising photographed June 11.

zh.t: 美国海军陆战队在古巴关塔那摩湾登陆
zh.s: 1898年6月10日，美西战争期间，美国海军陆战队一个营在古巴关塔那摩湾登陆。该营六个连中的四个连当天上岸，未遇抵抗，并在海湾东岸建立阵地。
zh.n: 这次登陆发生在6月10日；照片记录的升旗是在次日。

en.s: The Battle of Laing's Nek from 2–10 June 1900 was a series of actions in the Second Boer War between forces under Redvers Buller and the Boers of the Transvaal. At the time, Redvers Buller was advancing from Ladysmith to the Buffalo River, in an effort to cross into Volskrust, where he could then aid Lord Roberts in the Advance on Pretoria.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莱恩斯内克战役发生于1900年6月2日至10日，是第二次布尔战争期间的一系列战斗，交战双方为雷德弗斯·布勒率领的部队和德兰士瓦布尔人。当时，布勒正从莱迪史密斯向布法罗河推进，试图越境进入沃尔克斯勒斯特，从而支援罗伯茨勋爵向比勒陀利亚推进。

zh.s: 意大利于1900年6月3日举行大选，第二轮投票于6月10日进行。被称为“内阁派”的左翼阵营仍是议会第一大阵营，赢得508个席位中的296席。

en.s: The Battle of El Ksiba took place at El Ksiba in Morocco 8–10 June 1913. It was a battle in the French conquest of Morocco. Despite inflicting greater casualties on their enemy than they sustained themselves, the French Resident-General in Morocco, Hubert Lyautey, held the field commander Charles Mangin responsible for unacceptable losses. Mangin was removed from his command, and soon returned to France.

zh.s: 埃尔克西巴战役于1913年6月8日至10日在摩洛哥埃尔克西巴发生，是法国征服摩洛哥战争的一部分。法国军队给敌方造成的伤亡多于己方，但摩洛哥驻扎总督于贝尔·利奥泰仍认为前线指挥官夏尔·芒然损失过大，应对此负责。芒然被解除指挥职务，不久后返回法国。

en.s: The Second Battle of Garua took place from 31 May to 10 June 1915 during the Kamerun campaign of the First World War in Garua, German Kamerun. The battle was between a combined French and British force and defending German garrison and resulted in an Allied victory.

zh.s: 第二次加鲁阿战役于1915年5月31日至6月10日在德属喀麦隆的加鲁阿发生，是第一次世界大战喀麦隆战役的一部分。交战双方为法英联军和德军守备部队，最终联军获胜。

en.s: The siege of Medina lasted from 10 June 1916 to 10 January 1919, when Hejazi Arab rebels surrounded the Islamic holy city, which was then under the control of the Ottoman Empire. zh.s: 麦地那围城战从1916年6月10日持续到1919年1月10日。汉志阿拉伯叛军围困这座伊斯兰圣城，当时麦地那由奥斯曼帝国控制。奥斯曼帝国在苏丹穆罕默德五世领导下加入同盟国一方参战。

en.s: The Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), also known as the Great Arab Revolt (الثورة العربية الكبرى al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), was an armed uprising by the Hashemite-led Arabs of the Hejaz against the Ottoman Empire amidst the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I. On the basis of the McMahon–Hussein Correspondence, exchanged between Henry McMahon of the United Kingdom and Hussein bin Ali of the Kingdom of Hejaz, the rebellion against the ruling Turks was officially initiated at Mecca on 10 June 1916.

zh.s: 阿拉伯起义（阿拉伯语：الثورة العربية，al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya）也称大阿拉伯起义（الثورة العربية الكبرى，al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā），是第一次世界大战中东战场期间，由哈希姆家族领导的汉志阿拉伯人反抗奥斯曼帝国的武装起义。英国方面的亨利·麦克马洪与汉志王国国王侯赛因·本·阿里之间交换的《麦克马洪—侯赛因通信》为起义提供了依据；叛乱于1916年6月10日在麦加正式开始。

en.s: The Third Battle of Morlancourt was fought on 10 June 1918, on the Western Front during World War I. The battle took place during the final stages of the German spring offensive, and saw troops from the Australian 2nd Division carry out a dusk assault on the Morlancourt spur, which provided observation of the village of Sailly-Laurette, to the south of Morlancourt.

zh.s: 第三次莫朗库尔战役于1918年6月10日在第一次世界大战西线爆发，属于德国春季攻势的最后阶段。澳大利亚第2师部队在黄昏时分袭击莫朗库尔高地；该高地可俯瞰莫朗库尔以南的塞伊-洛雷特村。

en.s: The 1922 Tasmanian state election was held on 10 June 1922 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. The incumbent Premier of Tasmania was Walter Lee of the Nationalist Party. The Labor Party was led by Joseph Lyons.

en.s: The Battle of Bir Bilal (also called Battle of Brega) was a military engagement of the Second Italo-Senussi War on 10 June, 1923. The Sanusiyya won a resounding victory against the Italians.

zh.s: 比尔比拉之战（又称布雷加之战）是第二次意大利—塞努西战争中的一场战斗，发生于1923年6月10日。塞努西耶赢得了压倒性胜利，击败意大利军队。

en.s: The 1934 FIFA World Cup final was the second edition of the football quadrennial tournament match contested by the men's national teams of FIFA to determine the 1934 FIFA World Cup champions: Italy and Czechoslovakia. It took place on 10 June 1934 at the Stadio Nazionale PNF in Rome, Italy. After going a goal down, Italy came back to win the match 2–1 despite temperatures approaching 40 °C (104 °F).

zh.s: 1934年国际足联世界杯决赛是第二届世界杯赛事的决胜场，由意大利和捷克斯洛伐克两支男子国家队争夺冠军。比赛于1934年6月10日在意大利罗马的国家法西斯党体育场举行。尽管气温接近40摄氏度，意大利在先失一球后以2比1逆转获胜。

en.s: The 1939 Hawthorn state by-election was held on 10 June 1939 to elect the member for Hawthorn in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the death of United Australia Party (UAP) MP John Gray. Despite a 34% swing away from the UAP (two Independent UAP candidates were also contesting), Les Tyack won the seat for the UAP against Labor candidate Albert Nicholls with 54.1% of the two-party-preferred vote.

zh.s: 霍索恩选区于1939年6月10日举行维多利亚州立法议会补选，原因是联合澳大利亚党议员约翰·格雷去世。尽管联合澳大利亚党得票率下降34个百分点，而且另有两名该党独立候选人参选，该党候选人莱斯·泰亚克仍以两党优先票54.1%击败工党候选人阿尔伯特·尼科尔斯，赢得席位。

en.t: Mediterranean and Middle East theatre of World War II
en.s: The Mediterranean and Middle East theatre, also known as the Mediterranean Theater of War, and described as Mediterranean, South-East Europe, and North Africa 1939–1941 in Germany military history, was a major theatre of operations during the Second World War. It saw interconnected land, naval, and air campaigns fought for control of the Mediterranean Sea, North Africa, the Horn of Africa, the Middle East and Southern Europe. Despite their disparate geographic locations and objectives, these operations were not seen as neatly separated from each other, but part of an extensive, contiguous theatre of war. The Mediterranean theater had the longest duration of the Second World War. Combat started on 10 June 1940 with Italy's declaration of war against the United Kingdom and France and ended on 2 May 1945 when all Axis forces in Italy surrendered.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战地中海及中东战场
zh.s: 第二次世界大战地中海及中东战场也称地中海战区；德国军事史将1939至1941年部分战事称为地中海、东南欧和北非战场。这是第二次世界大战的主要战区之一，陆、海、空军围绕地中海、北非、非洲之角、中东和南欧的控制权展开相互关联的战役。尽管战事地点和目标各异，这些行动并非彼此割裂，而是构成一个连续的大型战区。战斗于1940年6月10日意大利向英国和法国宣战时开始，1945年5月2日意大利境内所有轴心国部队投降时结束。

en.s: The Battle of the Mediterranean was the naval campaign fought in the Mediterranean Sea during World War II. It began on 10 June 1940, when Italy declared war on the United Kingdom and France and bombed Malta the following day, and ended on 2 May 1945 with the formal surrender of German and Italian Fascist forces in Italy.

en.s: The Italian invasion of France (10–25 June 1940), also called the Battle of the Alps, was the first major Italian engagement of World War II and the last major engagement of the Battle of France. The Italian entry into the war widened its scope considerably in Africa and the Mediterranean Sea.

zh.s: 意大利入侵法国发生于1940年6月10日至25日，也称阿尔卑斯战役，是意大利在第二次世界大战中的首次重大交战，也是法国战役的最后一场重大交战。意大利参战使战争范围大幅扩展到非洲和地中海地区。

en.s: Operation Weserübung (Unternehmen Weserübung [ˈveːzɐˌʔyːbʊŋ], (German: "Operation Weser Exercise") was the invasion of Denmark and Norway by Nazi Germany during World War II. Taking place from 9 April – 10 June 1940, it was the opening operation of the Norwegian Campaign. In the early morning of 9 April 1940 (Wesertag, "Weser Day"), German forces occupied Denmark and invaded Norway, ostensibly as a preventive manoeuvre against a planned Anglo-French occupation of Norway known as Plan R 4, which developed as a response to a German invasion of Norwegian territory.

en.s: The Lidice massacre (Czech: Vyhlazení Lidic) was the complete destruction of the village of Lidice in the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia, which is now a part of the Czech Republic, in June 1942 on orders from Nazi leader Adolf Hitler and acting Reichsprotektor Kurt Daluege, successor to Reinhard Heydrich. It has gained historical attention as one of the most documented instances of German war crimes during World War II, particularly given the deliberate killing of children. In reprisal for the assassination of Reinhard Heydrich in the late spring of 1942, all 173 men and boys from the village aged 15 years or older were killed on 10 June 1942.

zh.s: 利迪策屠杀是纳粹德国领导人阿道夫·希特勒和代理帝国保护者库尔特·达吕格下令，于1942年6月彻底摧毁波希米亚和摩拉维亚保护国的利迪策村。该地现属捷克共和国。此事尤其因蓄意杀害儿童而引起关注，是第二次世界大战中记录最详尽的德国战争罪行之一。为报复1942年春末莱因哈德·海德里希遭刺杀，村里所有173名年满15岁的男性和男孩于1942年6月10日被杀害。

The subsequent highest priority campaigns were against V-weapon installations (June 1944) and petroleum, oil, and lubrication (POL) plants (September 1944).

en.s: (This article is about the 1944 massacre. For the village and surrounding commune, see Oradour-sur-Glane (commune).) On 10 June 1944, the village of Oradour-sur-Glane in Haute-Vienne in the Nazi-occupied France was destroyed, when 642 of its inhabitants, including women and children, were massacred by a Nazi Waffen-SS company. A new village was built nearby after the war, but French president Charles de Gaulle ordered the original maintained as a permanent memorial and museum.

Squadrons of B-25 Mitchell medium bombers and Typhoon fighter-bombers of the RAF Second Tactical Air Force attacked the château and its grounds with bombs and air-to-ground rockets.

en.t: Japanese 100th Division withdraws from the Davao area
en.s: On June 10, 1945, Japan's battered 100th Division withdrew from the Davao area into the mountains of Bukidnon as American and Filipino forces advanced on Mindanao. U.S. troops had entered Davao City on May 3, and fighting elsewhere on the island continued after June 10. The withdrawal marked a late stage of the Davao campaign, not the end of all fighting in the Philippines.
en.n: The retained battle article dates the 100th Division's withdrawal to June 10. Davao City had been entered on May 3; fighting and clearing operations continued beyond June 10.

zh.t: 日军第100师从达沃地区撤入山地
zh.s: 1945年6月10日，日军第100师在菲律宾棉兰老岛的战斗中失利，从达沃地区撤入布基农山区。美军和菲律宾部队继续推进。美军早在5月3日就已进入达沃市，6月10日以后岛上仍有战斗；这次撤退并不意味着菲律宾各地的战事就此结束。

en.s: The Battle of Porton Plantation (8–10 June 1945) took place near the village of Soraken on Bougainville Island, in the Solomon Islands archipelago during World War II. en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1957 was held June 10, 1957, to select the 265 members of the House of Commons of Canada. In one of the great upsets in Canadian political history, the Progressive Conservative Party (also known as "PCs" or "Tories"), led by John Diefenbaker, brought an end to 22 years of Liberal rule, as the Tories were able to form a minority government. The Liberal Party had governed Canada since 1935, winning five consecutive elections. Under Prime Ministers William Lyon Mackenzie King and Louis St. Laurent, the government gradually built a welfare state.

zh.s: 加拿大于1957年6月10日举行联邦大选，选出下议院265名议员。这次选举是加拿大政治史上的一次重大冷门：约翰·迪芬贝克领导的进步保守党结束了自由党长达22年的执政，并组成少数政府。自由党自1935年以来执政，连续赢得五次大选。在威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金和路易·圣洛朗两位总理任内，加拿大政府逐步建立起福利国家。

en.s: The sixth legislative assembly election of Tamil Nadu was held on June 10, 1977. Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (ADMK) won the election defeating its rival Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK). M. en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on 10 June 2004. Due to demographic changes in the Borough since its formation in 1973, and in common with most other English Councils in 2004, substantial boundary changes were implemented in time for these elections. Due to these changes, it was necessary for the whole Council to be re-elected for the first time since 1973. Each ward elected three candidates, with the first-placed candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2008, the second-placed candidate serving a three-year term of office, expiring in 2007, and the third-placed candidate serving a two-year term of office, expiring in 2006.

Due to demographic changes in the Borough since its formation in 1973, and in common with most other English Councils in 2004, boundary changes were implemented in time for these elections.

zh.s: 英格兰斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举于2004年6月10日举行，与其他地方选举同日。该自治市自1973年成立以来人口结构发生变化，与2004年英格兰大多数地方议会一样，此次选举前重新划分了选区。

en.s: The 2004 Chester City Council election took place on 10 June 2004 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

en.s: Local elections in Wales were held on 10 June 2004 to elect members to the twenty-two local authorities. They were held alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. The previous elections were held in 1999. The elections were originally scheduled for May 2003, but were delayed to avoid a conflict with the 2003 Wales Assembly elections.

zh.s: 威尔士于2004年6月10日举行地方选举，选出22个地方政府的议员，与英国其他地方选举同时举行。上次选举于1999年举行。此次选举原定于2003年5月举行，后为避免与2003年威尔士议会选举冲突而推迟。

en.s: The 2004 Cardiff Council election was the third election to the post-1996 Cardiff Council following the re-organisation of local government in Wales. It was held on 10 June 2004. It was preceded by the 1999 election and followed by the 2008 elections. On the same day, elections were held for the European Parliament as well as to the other 21 local authorities and to community councils in Wales as part of the 2004 Welsh local elections.

zh.s: 2004年卡迪夫市议会选举是1996年威尔士地方政府重组后，该议会举行的第三次选举，于2004年6月10日举行。上次选举在1999年举行，下一次在2008年举行。同一天，威尔士还举行了欧洲议会选举、其他21个地方政府选举和社区议会选举，这些选举都是2004年威尔士地方选举的一部分。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held for the first time in Gibraltar on 10 June 2004 as part of European Union-wide elections. Although part of the European Union, Gibraltar had never before voted in European Parliamentary elections, in part due to its small electorate of just over 20,000 which would cause Gibraltar to be over-represented by about 30 times if even a single seat were to be assigned.

zh.s: 直布罗陀于2004年6月10日首次举行欧洲议会选举，是全欧盟选举的一部分。尽管直布罗陀属于欧盟，但此前从未参加欧洲议会选举。原因之一是其选民只有略多于20,000人；如果分配哪怕一个席位，直布罗陀的代表比例也会高出约30倍。

en.s: The 2004 Reading Borough Council election was held on 10 June 2004, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales and the European elections. Following boundary changes the number of seats on Reading Borough Council had been increased from 45 to 46 with the creation of a new single-member ward called Mapledurham and changes to the boundaries of several existing wards.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会于2004年6月10日举行选举，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举以及欧洲选举同日。由于选区边界调整，议会席位从45席增加到46席，新设了单席的梅普尔德拉姆选区，并调整了若干现有选区的边界。

en.s: An election to the Assembly of London took place on 10 June 2004, along with the 2004 London mayoral election. The Assembly is elected by the Additional Member System. There are fourteen directly elected constituencies, nine of which were won by the Conservatives and five by the Labour Party. An additional eleven members were allocated by a London wide top-up vote, with the proviso that parties must win at least 5% of the vote to qualify for list seats.

zh.s: 伦敦议会选举于2004年6月10日举行，与2004年伦敦市长选举同日。议会采用附加议员制选举。14个议席由各选区直接选出，其中9席由保守党赢得，5席由工党赢得。另有11席按全伦敦范围的政党名单补充票分配；政党须至少获得5%的选票，才有资格取得名单席位。

en.s: The 2004 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 10 June 2004, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales and the European elections. 17 of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Knebworth ward.

zh.t: 2004年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会于2004年6月10日举行选举，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举及欧洲选举同日。49个席位中的17席改选，包括通常的三分之一席位，以及肯布沃思选区的一场补选。

en.s: Elections to Daventry District Council were held on 10 June 2004. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 达文特里区议会于2004年6月10日举行选举，改选三分之一席位。保守党继续掌握议会整体控制权。

en.s: The 2004 election to the post of Mayor of London took place on 10 June 2004. It was being held on the same day as other local elections and the UK part of the 2004 European Parliament elections, so Londoners had a total of five votes on three ballot papers. Polling opened at 07:00 local time, and closed at 22:00. See: 2004 United Kingdom elections.

zh.s: 2004年伦敦市长选举于2004年6月10日举行。当天还举行了其他地方选举和英国参加的2004年欧洲议会选举，因此伦敦选民要在三张选票上投五次票。投票于当地时间07:00开始，22:00结束。另见：2004年英国选举。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 10 June 2004. The whole council was up for election, with boundary changes since the last election in 2003 reducing the number of seats by nine. The Liberal Democrat party kept overall control of the council.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于2004年6月10日举行，议会全部席位都进行改选。自2003年上次选举以来，选区边界有所调整，席位总数减少了9个。自由民主党继续掌握议会多数。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Council, England were held on 10 June 2004. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 英格兰亨德本自治市议会选举于2004年6月10日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，保守党继续掌握议会多数。

en.t: 2004 European Parliament election in the United Kingdom
en.s: The 2004 European Parliament election was the United Kingdom's part of the wider 2004 European Parliament election which was held between 10 and 13 June 2004 in the 25 member states of the European Union. The United Kingdom's part of this election was held on Thursday 10 June 2004. The election also coincided with the 2004 local elections and the London Assembly and mayoral elections.

zh.s: 2004年欧洲议会选举是英国参与的一次选举，也是欧盟25个成员国于2004年6月10日至13日举行的欧洲议会选举的一部分。英国于2004年6月10日星期四投票。此次选举还与2004年地方选举、伦敦议会选举和伦敦市长选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2006 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Team Bath and Galleria Mavericks. Team Bath won the inaugural Netball Superleague title with a 43–35 win over Mavericks. Joanne Binns was prominent in both attack and defence as Team Bath fought back after going behind by three goals early on. The introduction Lynsey Armitage saw Mavericks launch a fightback but it was not enough.

zh.t: 2006年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2006年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛由Team Bath和Galleria Mavericks对阵。Team Bath以43比35获胜，夺得首届联赛冠军。Joanne Binns在进攻和防守两端都发挥突出；Team Bath开局一度落后3球，随后追回比分。Lynsey Armitage登场后，Mavericks一度反扑，但未能逆转。

en.s: Sudan Airways Flight 109 was an international scheduled Amman–Damascus–Khartoum passenger service, operated with an Airbus A310, that crashed on landing at Khartoum International Airport on 10 June 2008, approximately at 17:00 UTC, killing 30 of 214 occupants on board.

zh.s: 苏丹航空109号班机是一趟使用空客A310执飞的国际定期航班，航线为安曼—大马士革—喀土穆。2008年6月10日约世界协调时17时，飞机在喀土穆国际机场着陆时坠毁，机上214人中有30人死亡。

en.t: U.S. airstrike kills Pakistani troops near Gora Prai
en.s: Late on June 10, 2008, U.S. aircraft struck near Gora Prai in Pakistan's Mohmand border region during a clash involving coalition forces and militants. Pakistani officials said 11 members of the Frontier Corps were killed at a border post. The strike caused a sharp dispute between Pakistan and the United States over what had been targeted.
en.n: June 10 is the date of the Gora Prai airstrike, not the start date of every later Pakistan–United States border skirmish.

zh.t: 美军空袭戈拉普赖附近，巴基斯坦边防军遭遇伤亡
zh.s: 2008年6月10日晚，美军飞机在巴基斯坦莫赫曼德边境地区戈拉普赖附近发动空袭。当时联军与武装人员正在交战。巴基斯坦方面称，边境哨所的11名边防军人员被炸死。事后，巴基斯坦和美国对空袭目标及经过各执一词，双方关系因此紧张。
zh.n: 6月10日是戈拉普赖空袭发生的日期，不能把此后数年的巴美边境冲突都算作当天开始。

en.t: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum shooting
en.s: At approximately 12:50 p.m. on June 10, 2009, 88-year-old James Wenneker von Brunn entered the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum in Washington, D.C., with a slide-action rifle and fatally shot Museum Special Police Officer Stephen Tyrone Johns. Other special police officers returned fire, wounding von Brunn, who was apprehended. Von Brunn was charged in federal court on June 11, 2009, with first-degree murder and firearms violations.

zh.t: 美国大屠杀纪念馆枪击案
zh.s: 2009年6月10日中午12时50分左右，88岁的詹姆斯·温内克·冯·布伦手持一支滑动式步枪进入华盛顿特区的美国大屠杀纪念馆，开枪打死博物馆特别警察斯蒂芬·泰隆·约翰斯。其他特别警察还击，击伤冯·布伦并将其逮捕。2009年6月11日，冯·布伦在联邦法院被控一级谋杀和违反枪械法规。

en.s: The 2010 Chattogram City Corporation election was a local government election held in Chattogram, Bangladesh, on 10 June 2010 to elect the mayor of Chittagong and the city council. A total of 8 candidates contested the mayoral race. The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) candidate Mohammad Manjur Alam won the election. In the 55-member City Council, the Awami League won 31 seats, while the BNP and its allies won 22 seats, and the remaining seats were won by others.

zh.s: 孟加拉国吉大港于2010年6月10日举行地方选举，选出吉大港市长和市议会议员。共有8名候选人角逐市长职位。孟加拉国民族主义党候选人穆罕默德·曼朱尔·阿拉姆当选。市议会55席中，人民联盟赢得31席，民族主义党及其盟友赢得22席，其余席位由其他人获得。

en.s: The 2010 Libyan Cup final was the 20th final of the premier cup competition in the Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, the Libyan Cup. The match took place on June 10, 2010, at the 11 June Stadium in Tripoli. The match was contested by 2008 runners-up Madina and 2003 winners Nasr.

zh.s: 2010年利比亚杯决赛是利比亚阿拉伯民众国顶级杯赛——利比亚杯的第20场决赛。比赛于2010年6月10日在的黎波里的六月十一日体育场举行，对阵双方是2008年亚军马迪纳和2003年冠军纳斯尔。

en.s: MFC 30: Up Close and Personal was a mixed martial arts event held by the Maximum Fighting Championship (MFC) on June 10, 2011 at the Mayfield Inn Trade and Conference Centre in Edmonton, Alberta. The event was broadcast live on HDNet.

en.s: The 2011 International Origin was the inaugural edition of the International Origin match in the sport of rugby league. This match was between England and Exiles RL, and created to give England good mid-season opposition in preparation for the 2011 Four Nations in November.

zh.s: 2011年6月10日，首届国际Origin赛在英格兰利兹举行，Exiles队以16比12击败英格兰队。这场橄榄球比赛旨在让英格兰队为同年举行的四国赛练兵。

en.s: Slammiversary 10 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on June 10, 2012 at the College Park Center in Arlington, Texas on the University of Texas at Arlington campus. It was the eighth Pay-Per-View under the Slammiversary chronology, the sixth event in the 2012 TNA PPV schedule, and the company's largest domestically attended PPV at the time. TNA's Lockdown 2013 event drew a larger crowd since. With TNA having their origins date back to June 2002, the company commemorated and celebrated their 10 year anniversary.

zh.s: Slammiversary 10是Total Nonstop Action Wrestling（TNA）主办的一场职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2012年6月10日在德克萨斯州阿灵顿德克萨斯大学阿灵顿分校的College Park中心举行。这是Slammiversary系列第八场赛事，也是TNA 2012年按次付费赛事日程中的第六场，当时还是该公司在美国本土观众最多的一场此类赛事。2013年的Lockdown赛事后来吸引了更多观众。TNA成立于2002年6月，因此此次赛事也纪念了公司成立10周年。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 10 and 17 June 2012 (and on other dates for small numbers of voters outside metropolitan France) to select the members of the 14th National Assembly of the Fifth Republic, a little over a month after the presidential election run-off held on 6 May. All 577 single member seats in the assembly, including those representing overseas departments and territories and French residents overseas, were contested using a two-round system.

zh.s: 法国于2012年6月10日和17日举行国民议会选举，选出第五共和国第十四届国民议会议员；海外法国少数选民在其他日期投票。选举距5月6日举行的总统选举第二轮投票一个多月。国民议会全部577个单一选区席位均参与角逐，包括代表海外省、海外领地和海外法国居民的席位。选举采用两轮投票制。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Rome on 26–27 May and 9–10 June 2013 to elect the Mayor of Rome and 48 members of the City Council, as well as the fifteen presidents and more than 400 councillors of the 15 municipi in which the municipality is divided. In March 2013 the City Council cut down the number of municipi of the city from 19 to 15, reorganizing the local administrative areas.

zh.s: 罗马于2013年5月26日至27日和6月9日至10日举行市政选举，选出罗马市长、市议会48名议员，以及15个市辖区的区长和400多名议员。2013年3月，市议会将市辖区数量从19个减至15个，并重新划分了当地行政区域。

en.s: The fall of Mosul refers to a historical event in Iraq, occurring between 4 and 10 June 2014, when Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) and allied insurgents captured the city of Mosul from the Iraqi Army. The ISIL forces were initially led by Abu Abdulrahman al-Bilawi, while the Iraqi army's forces were led by Lieutenant General Mahdi al-Gharrawi.

zh.s: 摩苏尔陷落指2014年6月4日至10日发生在伊拉克的事件：伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国及其盟友叛乱分子从伊拉克军队手中夺取摩苏尔。伊斯兰国部队最初由阿布·阿卜杜拉赫曼·比拉维指挥，伊拉克军队则由中将马赫迪·加拉维指挥。

en.s: The 2017 Finns Party leadership election was held in Jyväskylä, Finland, on June 10, 2017, to elect the new chair of the Finns Party. All members of the party who had paid their subscription were allowed to vote in the election. The incumbent party chair, Timo Soini, who had led the party since 1997, did not run for the leadership this time.

en.s: On May 6, 2017, the city of San Antonio, Texas held an election to choose the next mayor of San Antonio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with candidates' party affiliations not appearing on the ballot. As no candidate secured a majority of the vote (50% of all votes cast +1), a runoff was held on June 10, 2017, with Councilman Ron Nirenberg defeating incumbent mayor Ivy Taylor.

zh.s: 日本新潟县于2018年6月10日举行知事选举。时任知事米山隆一因性丑闻于4月18日辞职。这也是新潟县将投票年龄降至18岁后的首次知事选举；外界原本预计选举会成为对米山政府反核电政策的一次实际公投。

en.t: 2023 Czech Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: A leadership election for the Czech Social Democratic Party (ČSSD) was held on 10 June 2023. Party congress decided the renaming of the party to Social Democracy (SOCDEM). Michal Šmarda was re-elected as the leader.

zh.t: 2023年捷克社会民主党领导人选举
zh.s: 捷克社会民主党于2023年6月10日举行领导人选举。党代表大会决定将党名改为“社会民主”（SOCDEM）。米哈尔·什马尔达再次当选党魁。

en.s: The 2023 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2022–23 UEFA Champions League, the 68th season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA. It was played at the Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul, Turkey, on 10 June 2023, between English club Manchester City and Italian club Inter Milan, with Manchester City winning 1–0 via a second-half goal by Rodri, who was named man of the match by UEFA.

zh.s: 2023年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2022–23赛季欧洲冠军联赛的最后一场比赛，也是这项由欧足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事的第68个赛季的决赛。比赛于2023年6月10日在土耳其伊斯坦布尔的阿塔图尔克奥林匹克体育场举行，由英格兰球队曼彻斯特城对阵意大利球队国际米兰。曼城凭借罗德里下半场的进球以1比0获胜，罗德里获欧足联评为全场最佳球员。

en.s: On 10 June 2024, a Malawian Defence Force Dornier 228 carrying Vice-President of Malawi Saulos Chilima, former First Lady Patricia Shanil Muluzi, and seven other occupants, crashed in Chikangawa Forest Reserve in Nkhata Bay District; all on board died in Malawi's deadliest aviation accident. At the time of the crash, the aircraft and its passengers were en route from Lilongwe to Mzuzu Airport in the Northern Region to attend a funeral.

zh.t: 2024年奇坎加瓦多尼尔228型飞机空难
zh.s: 2024年6月10日，一架马拉维国防军多尼尔228型飞机在恩卡塔湾区奇坎加瓦森林保护区坠毁。机上载有马拉维副总统萨乌洛斯·奇利马、前第一夫人帕特里夏·沙尼尔·穆卢齐及其他7人，所有人遇难。这是马拉维死亡人数最多的航空事故。当时飞机正从利隆圭飞往北部地区的姆祖祖机场，准备参加一场葬礼。

en.s: The 2024 Mississauga mayoral by-election was held on June 10, 2024, to elect the 7th mayor of Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, to serve the remainder of the 2022-2026 term following the resignation of mayor Bonnie Crombie. The election, held under first-past-the-post voting, was won by Carolyn Parrish, a city councillor and former member of Parliament (MP). She defeated fellow city councillors Alvin Tedjo, Dipika Damerla, Stephen Dasko, and 16 other candidates.

zh.s: 2024年密西沙加市长补选于2024年6月10日举行，选出安大略省密西沙加市第七任市长，任期为2022至2026届市议会剩余任期。此前市长邦妮·克罗姆比辞职。本次选举采用简单多数制，由市议员、前国会议员卡罗琳·帕里什胜出。她击败了同为市议员的阿尔文·泰乔、迪皮卡·达梅拉、斯蒂芬·达斯科，以及另外16名候选人。

en.s: On 10 June 2025, at 09:57 CEST, a mass shooting occurred at the Dreierschützengasse secondary school in Graz, Austria. The shooter killed 10 people and injured 11 others. The gunman died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound in the school lavatory and was identified as a 21-year-old former student at the school. The shooting was the deadliest rampage killing in modern Austrian history.

zh.s: 2025年6月10日中欧夏令时间9时57分，奥地利格拉茨的德赖尔舒岑巷中学发生大规模枪击案。枪手杀死10人，打伤11人，随后在校内厕所开枪自杀。警方确认枪手是该校一名21岁的前学生。这是现代奥地利史上死亡人数最多的一起大规模枪击事件。

en.t: Florida holds three state legislative special elections
en.s: Florida held special elections for state Senate District 19 and state House Districts 3 and 32 on June 10, 2025. These votes filled vacant legislative seats; they were three of several special elections held across the state that year. The state certified their results later in June.
en.n: June 10 is the polling date for these three districts, not the date of every Florida legislative special election in 2025.

zh.t: 佛罗里达州举行三场州议会补选
zh.s: 2025年6月10日，美国佛罗里达州举行三场州议会补选，分别选出州参议院第19选区、州众议院第3和第32选区的议员，填补空缺席位。这只是佛州当年多场补选中的三场；州政府在6月稍后才认证选举结果。
zh.n: 6月10日是这三个选区的投票日，并非2025年佛州所有州议会补选都在当天举行。
